quality.note:
M10 review candidate d3967b61 passed the unchanged normal 1431.357-second local staged gate and independent retained audit: 1,204 headless, 760 renderer and 289 tooling passes. Eight new credit functions pass once in each profile. The headless line/region measurements above are LOCAL; exact hosted CI41924068764 is pending, not passed. Separate renderer coverage is 10985/11255 lines and 16080/16763 regions. All required per-crate, workspace and changed-line gates pass strictly; CLI changed lines are 76/78. Four raw merges are byte-exact. A verified 24,459,152-byte durable lossless archive retains the complete local packet; raw RAM evidence also remains. Retention limits remain explicit: normal full-profile ELF paths are metadata-only, while six auxiliary ELF copies and existing local native-peer files are retained.

Viewer candidate 138f5759 passed normal hooks, exact CI41913892125, independent source/local/official audits and both unchanged 14 MB release budgets. An earlier new reset-fixture assertion was corrected to retain the existing UI fence until the fresh Scene; original assertions remain. The original browser overflow and earlier simulator scratch-capacity stop are preserved. Capacity was repaired by byte-preserving cache relocation and unchanged physical resource floors. No mandatory check, queue bound or numerical tolerance was weakened.

M10 is NOT accepted: exact simulator hosted verification, independent official review and actual matching browser spawn/remove/state/reset/reconnect observations remain. M1–M9 acceptance and deferred compatibility/Fuel scope are unchanged.

Historical accepted baseline and prior candidate evidence:
M9 Main 0f0f031e passed the normal 1411.351-second staged gate, exact hosted CI41817794153 (all 16 steps, attempt 1), and independent source/local/official/browser reviews. Actual results are 1,146 headless, 716 renderer and 289 tooling passes; five/four delegated ignored entries remain separate. Official headless coverage is 16131/16490 lines and 24042/24845 regions, versus 16135/16490 and 24046/24845 locally; the difference is four Server lines and regions. Renderer matches local at 9594/9834 lines and 14123/14750 regions. Scene renderer is 4724/4874 lines and 7159/7535 regions. Every owned crate, separate workspace profile and changed-line gate passes strictly, without union or relaxed thresholds.

The admitted chain uses maintained Rapier reduced coordinates and native torque-capped position/velocity motors. Position targets are continuous; prepared waypoint bias respects the configured target-speed bound. These are not hard physical speed caps or joint stops, and no native ABS/PID or general articulation parity is claimed. The accepted M8 motor policy and moving-parent effort refusals remain unchanged. Bad commands, constructor atomicity, identity, reset/removal, pending work, callback retirement and absent-family behavior pass. Earlier real tracking, compilation, regression-assumption and coverage failures remain preserved; all original numerical assertions and gates remain intact.

Independent audits checked 1,307 official Git blobs/modes and 610 source/input bindings. Four raw merges are byte-exact from 1752/358/14/33 official inputs; local renderer has 354. Six actual auxiliary ELF copies are retained; 291 full-profile executable records are metadata-only. Existing native-free and camera feature proofs and five depth/four RGB/34 support controls pass. Nine existing C++ peer chains and remote SDK identities retain provenance, but remote DSO bytes were not archived or locally rehashed. No new controller C++ parity or performance qualification is claimed.

Five independently viewed browser images show three visuals, real base/child motion from canonical Double commands, pause acknowledged at epoch 0/time 59.315 seconds and reset at epoch 1/time zero with restored poses. The finite sender was built once in 26.992 seconds with its full normal Cargo JSON and actual executable retained. Command exits/timing are coordinator observations, not independent execution logs; screenshots do not measure angles or encoded IDs. Accepted viewer 19be release bundles and Main 516a docs/test-clock child are reused unchanged. Accepted manual qualification was not replayed.

M9 acceptance metadata follows its normal required gate/CI while isolated M10 source progresses. Legacy P0–P7, broader system inventory, upstream and independent Fuel evidence stay unchanged. M10 is the next delivery target; full compatibility remains an unscheduled backlog.

M10 update: simulator review candidate 2094159e passed local verification, exact CI41862346228 attempt 3 and independent retained evidence audits. Attempts 1 and 2 remain recorded snapshot HTTP 503/500 setup failures. Viewer diagnostic candidate 74496593 passed exact CI41891459744, local/official audits and both unchanged 14 MB release budgets. Actual browser diagnostics then confirmed queue overflow. These candidate checks do not transfer M10 acceptance; quality metrics above remain the accepted M9 baseline.
